questions.question: Find the mean, median, mode and range of 3, 5, 5, 6, 8, 9, 13.
Find the median of 4, 7, 9, 12.
questions.expected_answer: The middle two are 7 and 9, so the median is (7 + 9) ÷ 2 = 8.

questions.question: Pocket money: R20, R25, R25, R30, R200. Which average describes a typical learner best, and why?
questions.expected_answer: The median, R25. The outlier R200 pulls the mean up to R60, above what four of the five learners receive.
